detail.title: 弹性可搬运辅助体
detail.abstract: The invention relates to a flexible portable auxiliary body, which mainly comprises a lifting handle, a connector, a flexible anti-collision body, an information transmitting and receiving connecting rod, a support body and a flexible connector. The flexible portable auxiliary body has the characteristics that the operation is simple, the use is convenient and the design is reasonable, and is a handheld device which is more comfortable in use.
assignees: 青岛盛鑫琴院机电科技有限公司
